purpose: Selection-only artifact identifying the next 22 highest-risk REQ_IDs across U0, L1, L0/L3, C0, PA, L2, Exit, L4/UWG, L5, L6, and E2E that are NOT already in Tier 0 (17 rows) or Tier 1 (15 rows). No proof, no implementation, no Tier 2 gate yet.
selection_disclaimer: Static selection. No runtime behavior, replay machinery, OTEL exporter, or proof harness was executed. No new tests were authored. Tier 2 evidence work is intentionally deferred.

selected.requirement_text: Only a ValidatedRequest MUST be handed off to L1; raw requests MUST NOT cross the U0→L1 boundary.
selected.why_tier2: Sole-path U0→L1 boundary not covered by Tier 0/1; bypass would inject unvalidated requests into the entire downstream chain.
selected.likely_required_evidence: ValidatedRequest schema receipt, U0→L1 handoff trace span, rejection of any non-ValidatedRequest payload at the boundary
selected.likely_test_gap: Negative-control test that injects a raw (non-ValidatedRequest) payload at the U0→L1 boundary and asserts hard rejection
selected.likely_artifact_gap: U0_handoff_receipt.json carrying validated_request_id and identity binding
selected.likely_replay_gap: Replay pair scenario_U0_validated_handoff_run_{1,2}.json verifying boundary determinism
selected.likely_negative_control_gap: raw_request_at_u0_l1_boundary_negctrl.json proving rejection emits the expected reason

selected.requirement_text: Any path that skips intake validation MUST be detected by anti-bypass tests.
selected.why_tier2: Tier 1 covers L2/L4/L6/Exit/UWG/Gate/C0 anti-bypass surfaces; U0 anti-bypass is the missing intake-layer counterpart.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Anti-bypass scan output proving every alternative path through U0 is detected
selected.likely_test_gap: Static AST scan or runtime probe that discovers any U0-skipping path
selected.likely_replay_gap: Replay pair demonstrating the skip-path detector is deterministic across runs
selected.likely_negative_control_gap: synthetic_u0_skip_path_negctrl.json proving the detector flags it

selected.requirement_text: Origin trust MUST be injected at intake and carried as a request label.
selected.why_tier2: Complements Tier 1 REQ-L5-ORIGIN-TRUST-BOUNDARY-001 by proving the upstream injection point at U0; without this the L5 boundary protects nothing.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Trust label written into request envelope at intake and surviving to L5 boundary check
selected.likely_test_gap: End-to-end trust-label propagation test from U0 through L5
selected.likely_replay_gap: Replay pair showing identical trust-label propagation across two runs

selected.requirement_text: L1 MUST hand off via the canonical L1PlanContract; ad-hoc payloads MUST NOT cross to L0.
selected.why_tier2: Sole-path L1→L0 boundary; equivalent of UWG-WRITE-SOLE-PATH but for the planning layer. Not covered by Tier 0/1.
selected.likely_required_evidence: L1PlanContract instance with canonical schema fingerprint at every L1→L0 transition
selected.likely_test_gap: Negative-control test injecting an ad-hoc plan payload at L1→L0 and asserting boundary rejection
selected.likely_artifact_gap: l1_plan_contract_handoff_receipt.json with contract version and digest
selected.likely_replay_gap: Replay pair verifying L1PlanContract digest is stable across runs

selected.requirement_text: L1 MUST NOT perform retrieval; retrieval is C0's authority.
selected.why_tier2: Authority-boundary at L1 not covered by Tier 0/1 (Tier 0 covers PA-no-retrieval; this is the L1 sibling).
selected.likely_required_evidence: Static + runtime evidence that L1 never invokes the retrieval surface
selected.likely_test_gap: Code-graph scan + runtime span-absence assertion at L1
selected.likely_replay_gap: Replay pair where L1 spans never include a retrieval call

selected.requirement_text: L1 MUST NOT execute tools or perform downstream work. L1 emits planning artifacts only; execution is L2's authority.
selected.why_tier2: L1→L2 authority boundary; complements Tier 0 PA-NO-EXECUTE and L2-NO-DIRECT-L4 by closing the L1 side.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Evidence that L1 emits no L2-bound execution calls
selected.likely_test_gap: Code-graph scan + runtime tool-invocation absence at L1
selected.likely_replay_gap: Replay pair confirming L1 has zero tool-execution spans

selected.requirement_text: L0 MUST NOT perform retrieval; retrieval is C0's authority.
selected.why_tier2: L0 retrieval boundary; Tier 0 covers L0-ROUTE-EXACTLY-ONE but not L0-NO-RETRIEVAL.
selected.likely_required_evidence: L0 spans show zero retrieval calls
selected.likely_test_gap: Code-graph scan + span-absence at L0
selected.likely_replay_gap: Replay pair confirming L0 retrieval-call count is zero across runs

selected.requirement_text: L3→L2 step handoff MUST be checkpointed for deterministic resume.
selected.why_tier2: L3 orchestration checkpointing not covered by Tier 0/1 (Tier 1 covers L4 replay-snapshot-audit; this is the orchestration sibling).
selected.likely_required_evidence: Checkpoint records at every L3→L2 step boundary with stable digest
selected.likely_test_gap: Resume-from-checkpoint deterministic test
selected.likely_replay_gap: Replay pair resumes from same checkpoint and produces identical output

selected.requirement_text: C0 evidence fetch MUST execute only the published retrieval plan.
selected.why_tier2: Sole-path retrieval execution; Tier 0 covers C0-EVIDENCE-NO-ANSWER but not the retrieval-plan adherence boundary.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Diff between published plan and executed fetches is empty
selected.likely_test_gap: Plan-vs-fetch diff validator
selected.likely_replay_gap: Replay pair confirms fetch trace is byte-equal to plan trace

selected.requirement_text: C0 MUST NOT execute tools or models; execution is L2's authority.
selected.why_tier2: C0→L2 authority boundary; complements Tier 0 PA-NO-EXECUTE.
selected.likely_required_evidence: C0 spans show zero tool/model execution calls
selected.likely_test_gap: Code-graph scan + span-absence at C0
selected.likely_replay_gap: Replay pair confirms zero execution spans at C0

selected.requirement_text: PA provider-aware rendering MUST use only declared provider templates.
selected.why_tier2: Sole-path on PA prompt rendering; Tier 1 covers PA-FINAL-EMIT-ARTIFACT and PA-AUTHORITY-REDTEAM but not the template-allowlist boundary.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Diff between rendered prompt template id and declared allowlist is empty
selected.likely_test_gap: Allowlist-diff validator
selected.likely_replay_gap: Replay pair confirms identical template id is used

selected.requirement_text: PA MUST run the airlock security pass before final emit.
selected.why_tier2: Pre-final-emit security pass; Tier 1 covers final-emit artifact integrity, this covers the upstream security gate that protects it.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Airlock-security-pass receipt with verdict for every emit
selected.likely_test_gap: Detector test for pre-emit bypass attempts
selected.likely_replay_gap: Replay pair has identical airlock verdict and score

selected.requirement_text: Programmatic tool calling MUST occur inside the PTC sandbox.
selected.why_tier2: Sandbox isolation invariant; Tier 0 covers L2-EXECUTE-BOUNDED-PACKET but not sandbox enforcement on programmatic tool calls.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Span attribute confirming PTC sandbox context for every tool invocation
selected.likely_test_gap: Out-of-sandbox PTC attempt detector
selected.likely_replay_gap: Replay pair with identical sandbox attributes

selected.requirement_text: L2 verify-then-execute local critique MUST run before binding the execution attempt.
selected.why_tier2: Pre-execution critique gate; not covered by Tier 0/1 which focus on post-execution write boundaries.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Verify-then-execute receipt for every L2 attempt with verdict and rationale digest
selected.likely_test_gap: Detector test for skipped verification before execute
selected.likely_replay_gap: Replay pair with identical pre-execute verdict

selected.requirement_text: Exit and runtime gates MUST NOT duplicate the same decision in the same run.
selected.why_tier2: Cross-system non-overlap; complements Tier 1 EXIT-X1G-X1I-REPLAY by ensuring no double-decisioning between Exit and runtime gates.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Diff between Exit decisions and runtime-gate decisions per run is disjoint
selected.likely_test_gap: Per-run decision-set disjointness validator
selected.likely_replay_gap: Replay pair with identical disjoint decision sets

selected.requirement_text: Retrieval surface state MUST be read-only from non-UWG paths.
selected.why_tier2: Read-only invariant on retrieval surface; complements Tier 1 L4-NO-DIRECT-WRITE-FROM-L2/L6 by enforcing read-only outside UWG.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Static + runtime evidence that no non-UWG path mutates the retrieval surface
selected.likely_test_gap: Mutation-on-retrieval-surface detector
selected.likely_replay_gap: Replay pair confirms no off-UWG retrieval-surface mutation

selected.requirement_text: L4 cache state MUST be invalidated through declared invalidation contracts only.
selected.why_tier2: Cache-invalidation sole-path; not covered by Tier 0/1.
selected.likely_required_evidence: All cache-invalidation calls carry the declared contract id
selected.likely_test_gap: Off-contract invalidation detector
selected.likely_replay_gap: Replay pair with identical contract_ids and ordering

selected.requirement_text: Risk tier band assignment MUST use the published bands and never an ad-hoc score.
selected.why_tier2: Risk-tier schema sole-path; complements Tier 1 L5-SAFETY-ENFORCE-PLANE.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Every risk_tier value matches a published band id
selected.likely_test_gap: Schema-conformance validator on every risk_tier assignment
selected.likely_replay_gap: Replay pair with identical band ids per record

selected.requirement_text: HITL reclearance MUST be requested for governance-flagged inputs prior to L2 execution.
selected.why_tier2: Pre-execution governance gate; not covered by Tier 0/1.
selected.likely_required_evidence: HITL reclearance request emitted before L2 for every governance-flagged input
selected.likely_test_gap: Detector for governance-flagged input reaching L2 without reclearance
selected.likely_replay_gap: Replay pair with identical reclearance verdicts

selected.requirement_text: L6 signal fusion / RCA MUST be derived only from sealed eval records.
selected.why_tier2: Sole-path on RCA inputs; complements Tier 1 L6-GAUNTLET-FUTURE-RUN by enforcing the input-side firewall.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Every fusion / RCA record is keyed by sealed eval record id only
selected.likely_test_gap: Detector for unsealed-input fusion attempts
selected.likely_replay_gap: Replay pair with identical sealed-input set

selected.requirement_text: Mutation tests MUST exercise declared boundary faults across U0/L1/L0/C0/PA/L2/Exit/L6.
selected.why_tier2: Mutation coverage across boundaries protects against false-confidence in passing E2E suites; not covered by Tier 0/1.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Mutation matrix output with at least one fault per declared boundary, all detected
selected.likely_test_gap: Mutation-matrix-coverage validator
selected.likely_replay_gap: Replay pair with identical mutation-detected verdicts
selected.likely_negative_control_gap: undetected_boundary_mutation_negctrl.json proving the matrix flags it

selected.requirement_text: E2E proofs MUST verify each declared inter-layer contract is emitted and consumed.
selected.why_tier2: Contract-emission audit across the run; complements Tier 0 TRACE-OTEL-CRITICAL-SPANS by enforcing the contract-flow ledger end-to-end.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Every declared inter-layer contract has matched emit + consume events per run
selected.likely_test_gap: Emit/consume parity validator for the contract registry
selected.likely_replay_gap: Replay pair with identical emit/consume pair counts
selected.likely_negative_control_gap: missing_contract_consumer_negctrl.json proving the validator detects it
